title: About TikSaveMP4
description: Learn how TikSaveMP4 saves public TikTok videos and photo slideshows, which formats are available, and what source quality and access limits mean.
sections: What we do

TikSaveMP4 checks public TikTok post links and prepares available videos or photo slideshows for download. Save a video as MP4, save an individual image, or package photo slides in their original order as a ZIP.
What to expect

Available quality depends on the source. Some posts are blocked by TikTok, unavailable in your region, private, deleted or limited to signed-in users. We do not ask for TikTok passwords or login cookies.
Independent service
TikSaveMP4 is not affiliated with TikTok or ByteDance. Downloading does not grant permission to republish someone else’s work. Respect copyright and keep creator attribution.

title: Contact TikSaveMP4
description: Get help with TikTok video, image, or ZIP downloads. Find out which link, device details, and error message to include when contacting TikSaveMP4.
sections: Download help

Include the public TikTok post link, your browser and device, and the exact error message. Say whether the error happened while checking the link, preparing the file, or saving it. Never send passwords or login cookies.
Access limits
Check that the link is a public video or photo post. Private, deleted and region-restricted posts may be unavailable. Repeated requests cannot remove these restrictions.

title: Privacy policy
description: Read how TikSaveMP4 processes TikTok links, temporary download files, operational records, and optional analytics, plus your privacy choices.
sections: Links and temporary files

Submitted public TikTok links are sent to the server for validation, extraction and file preparation. Download jobs and media files are temporary and expire after the configured retention period, which defaults to 15 minutes. We do not need your TikTok password.
Operational records

The server uses request information for rate limiting and may record download outcomes, error categories, timestamps and operational logs. Hosting infrastructure may log IP addresses. Administrator sessions use essential cookies.
Third-party connections

The server contacts TikTok and its media delivery networks. Preview images load directly from those networks, which can receive your IP address. Optional Google Analytics is disabled in the supplied production configuration; if enabled later, regional policy and visitor preferences apply.
Your choices
Do not submit private information. Use the contact page to ask about privacy or deletion. You can opt out of optional analytics using the link below.

title: Terms of use
description: Read the terms for using TikSaveMP4, including permitted downloads, copyright responsibilities, temporary files, service limits, and source availability.
sections: Permitted use

Use the service to save content you own or have permission to download. Respect creators, copyright, privacy and applicable platform terms. Do not use this service to bypass private-account access controls.
Availability and quality
The service depends on publicly accessible source media. Access and formats may change without notice. No guarantee is made about availability, watermark removal or source quality.
Fair use of the service
Do not abuse the service through excessive automation, harmful links or attempts to defeat rate limits. Temporary download links expire; keep your own copies of authorized originals.

title: Copyright
description: Learn about creator rights when saving TikTok content, permitted reuse, and the information to provide when reporting a copyright concern to TikSaveMP4.
sections: Creator rights
Rights to downloaded content remain with the original rights holders. TikSaveMP4 is an independent tool and does not grant a licence to reuse or republish a work.
Report a concern
Send the public post URL, a description of the original work, your relationship to the rights holder and a contact method. Avoid sending unnecessary personal documents in an initial request.
